model_boundary: The live function is a fastcall-style no-stack-argument method using ECX as a context receiver. The staging function passes that context and the separate PropertyRecord, Galaxy/game-entry, GameMode, behavior-cleanup, and allocation services explicitly; no shared map or event-family type is recreated.

live_abi.calling_convention: fastcall-style method; Ghidra reports unknown convention
live_abi.return_observation: The function returns after the final guarded cleanup/free sequence and has no value return.

mechanics: Initialize and append three independent 0x24-byte property records in fixed order: key 0x2dd90af/value 0x366a930d, key 0x3cc89b1/value 0x913b23be, and key 0x54a32960/value 1.
The record initializer writes the observed tag 0x2e1a75d at +0x04, the value at +0x08, value+1 at +0x0c, and zeroes the remaining observed words.
After each append, invoke the record-range cleanup boundary and release the owned temporary pointer when its four-byte prefix is nonzero.
Obtain the Galaxy/game-entry descriptor range from the service owner returned by FUN_0067CB40, whose live vtable +0x38 supplies the range.
Copy each 0x0c-byte descriptor to a local three-word record and pass it to the entry index lower-bound boundary.
Initialize the game-mode boundary only when the index result equals the context anchor at +0x3c; a non-anchor candidate is skipped.
Invoke the behavior cleanup boundary after the descriptor loop.
Release the descriptor range pointer when its four-byte prefix is nonzero, clean the secondary record range, then release that range pointer when its prefix is nonzero.

property_record.policy: Property records are separate from PropertyList and from the Galaxy/game-entry descriptors; unknown words remain opaque.

game_entry_descriptor.policy: The three words are copied to a local record and are not assigned Galaxy or game-mode semantic names.

entry_index.search: 0x00A21DC0 lower-bound-shaped search over the three descriptor words
entry_index.filter: Only an anchor result reaches the game-mode initialization boundary.

game_mode.role: initializes a game mode from a descriptor; separate from the Galaxy service owner

behavior_cleanup.role: behavior-manager cleanup boundary; separate from game-mode initialization and event families

allocation.role: conditional owned-pointer release after a nonzero four-byte prefix

context_offsets.role: behavior/cache list word observed by FUN_00DE7010
map root word observed by FUN_00A21DC0

related_structures.role: related Galaxy UI type; not a target-state assertion

structures_and_globals.event_boundary: No event family is created or consumed by the target; service-owner and behavior cleanup boundaries remain separate from event lifecycle reconstruction.

strings.observation: The target uses hashed property/descriptor words rather than direct string literals; the GGE string belongs to the separate game-mode initialization dependency.

tests: property-list text application and type-10 item-cost application
same-list no-ref/no-release and null-list replacement release
three property record initializers and append/cleanup/free order
anchor result initializes the copied game descriptor
non-anchor index result suppresses game-mode initialization
empty and invalid descriptor ranges perform cleanup without descriptor initialization
final behavior cleanup, descriptor-range free, secondary record cleanup, and secondary free order
unresolved_questions: The concrete Galaxy/game-entry service owner type and the vtable +0x38 return contract are not named by Ghidra.
The three descriptor words and their relationship to Galaxy coordinates, game IDs, and game-mode selection remain unknown.
The three property records' opaque words and the exact ownership of their allocated buffers are not closed by this body.
The behavior/cache list at context+0x40 and the secondary record range ownership remain opaque.
The live body has no explicit null or reversed-range guard; the staging descriptor_count guard is a model safety boundary and not a recovered source branch.
The game-mode initialization and behavior cleanup services are separate dependencies; no event lifecycle is inferred here.
blockers: A linkable runtime model for the service owner, descriptor map, property record allocator, and game-mode manager is not available without changing the integrated PKG-12 boundary.
Concrete vtable targets and service return types remain unresolved even though their call order and record widths are preserved.
Empty/invalid range behavior is modeled defensively; the live implementation may fault on malformed service-returned ranges.
